title: A subject or source record is deleted while work is pending
description: A subject or source record is deleted (privacy deletion or source-side removal) while a case or workflow still references it; derived context and pending work must stop using it.
callerVisible: A follow-up never repeats deleted information; the caller is told a person will review the request.
backendEvidence: Deletion tombstone propagated to derived stores
Pending work held for a person
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:SOURCE_DELETED] owned by WP-24 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: a subject or source record is deleted while work is pending

postconditions: Deleted data is not served from derived context, memory or knowledge
Pending work referencing it is held for a person
